done.evidence: #1 to #10: she started with 'Find my level' and reached the verdict without outside help.
#10 B1 is near A2. Her reaction: 'B1 feels a bit high for me', which is acceptable, and the app says 'it may be a little off'.
#5-#9 each task had clear instructions and an 'I don't know' button, and she answered every one.
#2 'Answer in English or in your own language'. Her apologies got a kind reply at #3: 'Your English is clear enough'.
#10 the summary names her 'because' linking and the broken-shower call. The focus 'Say a little more in each answer' is fairly generic.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: Task 3 (#7): in-app partial. I'd call it fail at B2, because of article and agreement errors ('the staff is'). Task 4 (#8): in-app fail, but the note praises the answer. I'd call it partial.

judge.voice: I liked it. The questions were about my hotel, so I did not feel tested, and when I said sorry it just said my English was clear enough. I understood every task. The shower listening was good, because that is a real call. B1 feels a little high to me, and even the comments say my small words are missing, so I do not fully trust it. But it says it may be a little off, and that is honest. The two opinion questions were hard. The next step, "say a little more", is not very specific. I would try it again for 15 minutes after the children sleep, and nothing I saw worries me as a mother. Dobrý začátek.
